Name: Full House Poker
Description: Texas Hold'em against tables of other players, with a career of tournaments to climb.

Achievements.Name: Stylish Host
Achievements.Description: Start a game with customized table and card styles.

Achievements.Name: Pull the Trigger
Achievements.Description: Bet or raise on every street in a hand and then win the showdown.

Achievements.Name: Gone Fishing
Achievements.Description: Win a showdown with a hand you made on the river.

Achievements.Name: Headshot
Achievements.Description: Bust another player in a tournament.

Achievements.Name: Pay the Mortgage
Achievements.Description: Take a pot equal to twice the starting chips or greater.

Achievements.Name: Cardrack
Achievements.Description: Win two consecutive hands in the showdown.

Achievements.Name: Hero Call
Achievements.Description: Call, raise, or go all in on a bet of half the pot or greater and then win the showdown.

Achievements.Name: Sandbagger
Achievements.Description: Do not bet or raise for at least one entire street in a hand and then win the showdown.
